verdict.rationale: The pack shows no natural-language command interface in Viam itself. The docs describe an external AI agent driving machines through the CLI or SDKs with JSON in and JSON out, and the platform publishes an llms.txt file. Both are developer building blocks for a third-party agent, not a product-native way to operate Viam with natural-language commands, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
